about: An answer asked for again and given as it was before, word for word, nothing it bears on changed since: told as given again, not again in full, for what it said is in the Notes (the boredom census, BO-10: Honoria's tea-shop and Hulda's work told word for word each time they were asked). {actor} is the one answering.

lines.text: {Actor} tells you again, much as before.
{Actor} goes over it again for you, in the same words as before.
‘As I said,’ says {actor}, and tells it you again.
{Actor} tells it you over again, patiently. Nothing in it has changed.
